ANTIFRAUD::alert_forbidden_added_element
Description
This command returns forbidden added HTML element and its content, in
an escaped base64 format.
Syntax
ANTIFRAUD
::
alert_forbidden_added_element
Examples
when
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
{
log
local0.
"Alert forbidden added element: [ANTIFRAUD::alert_forbidden_added_element]."
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
